out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 82F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINK NEEDS TO MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM. PIC CONTACTED A TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE SINK DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF OF CORRECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: OBSERVED INACCURATE UNIT THERMOMETER IN SMALL 1-DOOR COOLER AND NO THERMOMETER IN THE COOLER IN THE SEATING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COOLERS WITH TCS FOODS NEED TO HAVE AN ACCURATE UNIT THERMOMETER. THE FRONT COOLER WILL ONLY BE USED FOR NON-TCS DRINKS UNLESS IT CAN HOLD TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: GARLIC PEEL manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE REUSING THESE CONTAINERS TO STORE FOOD ITEMS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: STOVE-BURNERS/EXTERIOR OF COOK-LINE EQUIPMENT AND SANDWICH PRESS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE THIS EQUIPMENT IS CLEANED MORE FREQUENTLY TO PREVENT GRIME ACCUMULATION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FLOORS/WALLS AROUND COOK-LINE, UNDER THE THREE-VAT SINK, AND AROUND REFRIGERATORS/FREEZERS ARE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE THE ENTIRE BACK KITCHEN IS CLEANED THOROUGHLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND CLEANING FREQUENCY INCREASES TO PREVENT GRIME BUILD UP IN THE FUTURE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MULTIPLE TRAYS OF COOKED LAMB AT 50-52F (OVERNIGHT) AND MILK AT 46F (OVERNIGHT) IN ONE-DOOR STAND-UP
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOOD DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the KITCHEN WAS PLUGGED WITH PAPER TOWELS, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. FOOD WORKER STATED THEY DO NOT USE THE HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: PAPER TOWELS REMOVED AND PIC RE-EDUCATED. USE HANDWASHING SINK AS DIRECTED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON THE PREP-COUNTERS: COOKED PASTA AT 85F, CUT TOMATO AT 72F. PIC STATED THEY WERE REMOVED FROM COLD HOLDING 1HR PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ITEMS MOVED TO COOLER. CEASE HOLDING FOODS AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. TCS FOODS MUST BE HELD ABOVE 135F OR BELOW 41F.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED TILAPIA FULLY THAWED IN COOLER WITH PACKAGES INTACT.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: FISH DISPOSED OF. TILAPIA PACKAGES MUST BE CUT AS SOON AS THEY ARE REMOVED FROM THE FREEZER. CEASE THAWING WITHOUT CUTTING THE PACKAGES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: OBSERVED WHOLE LIMES STORED BELOW THREE-VAT SINK BESIDE A CONTAINER OF BLEACH.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. CDI: LIMES THROWN AWAY. ALL FOOD MUST BE STORED SO IT WILL NOT BE CONTAMINATED. KULAN CAFE (Inspection Date: 07/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED VARIOUS FOODS IN PACKAGES STORED ON THE FLOOR THROUGHOUT THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED PLASTIC CUPS AND BOWLS IN DRY FOOD STORAGE BINS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CUPS AND BOWLS MUST BE REPLACED WITH SCOOPS WITH THE HANDLES FULLY OUT OF THE FOOD SO FOOD IS NOT CONTAMINATED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED ONE-DOOR STAND UP FREEZER BEING USED AS A COOLER. FREEZER NO LONGER HOLDS FOODS FROZEN.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. THIS UNIT MUST BE REPAIRED OR REPLACED. UNIT IS NOT MEANT TO BE USED AS A COOLER AND IS NOT DEPENDABLE TO CONTINUALLY HOLD FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW IF IT CANNOT HOLD FOODS FROZEN.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS WILL PROVIDE DOCUMENT VIA EMAIL.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL PROVIDE DOCUMENT VIA EMAIL.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: observed employee wash a rice scoop and not sanitize it before using it.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS HAD EMPLOYEE SANITIZE RICE SCOOP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: outside of the stove and large dry storage containers
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the wall behind the cook line and the floor around equipment in the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
